title: source-gates flaked: candidate-bundle test "a bundle refuses committed platform artifacts off a release ref, and refuses rebuilds on one" timed out at 5000ms
description: Flake observed during the quest-cli 0.13.0 promotion, 2026-10-07. PR opum-ai/quest-cli#534 (dev to main promotion, head ac2b3d2c): source-gates run 37655469734 FAILED at 6m28s on exactly one test -- "a bundle refuses committed platform artifacts off a release ref, and refuses rebuilds on one" in test/e2e/release/candidate-bundle.test.ts, message "this test timed out after 5000ms" (measured 5000.16ms); 75 pass / 1 fail; the run also logged "killed 1 dangling process". The SAME tree had just PASSED source-gates on PR #533 (head 0ea5ea17, 5m26s) minutes earlier, and a re-run of the failed job then passed (6m5s) on identical content -- so it is the test per-test 5000ms default timeout, not a defect in the release. The test performs build/compile work that can exceed 5s under runner load, which reddens a required gate and blocks a promotion for no real fault. Worked around by re-running the job once (the promotion then went through); this task is the real fix.

acceptanceCriteria.text: test/e2e/release/candidate-bundle.test.ts no longer fails at the fixed 5000ms default: the refuses-committed-platform-artifacts-off-a-release-ref test either carries a timeout derived from a measured CI duration, or no longer performs work that can exceed the default -- so the same tree does not pass source-gates on one run and fail on another.
The chosen timeout, or the removal of the slow work, is justified by a duration read from a CI run log rather than guessed.
